study_design: Case-control study of newly diagnosed prostate cancer cases and healthy controls
reason: The abstract evaluates overall newly diagnosed prostate cancer and does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Moreover, serum levels of folate, total homocysteine, and vitamin B12 were not significantly associated with prostate cancer risk (p > 0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: The vitamin B12 estimate concerns overall prostate cancer risk, not aggressive disease.
